Loader tacit/data/agentdojo.py skips rows whose security is None or whose error is set and labels a row unsafe when security is False (https://github.com/CSSLab/Tacit/blob/995692d3cd42c32e08cf0db8a5fae55fec272f1a/tacit/data/agentdojo.py). Collection: scripts/data/collect_agentdojo.sh serves the model with vLLM (max-model-len 32768, auto tool choice, parser hermes for Qwen / llama3_json for Llama), runs `python -m agentdojo.scripts.benchmark --model <VLLM_PARSED|LOCAL> -ml agentdojo_compat --benchmark-version v1.2.2 -s <suite>` for attack none then important_instructions, four suites in parallel; it writes per-suite process logs and vllm_server.log next to the runs, none of which is in the tree (https://github.com/CSSLab/Tacit/blob/995692d3cd42c32e08cf0db8a5fae55fec272f1a/scripts/data/collect_agentdojo.sh). scripts/data/agentdojo_compat.py is a pydantic-2.13 workaround (TaskResults.model_rebuild, cf. AgentDojo #88). tacit/config.py maps qwen3-4b-instruct -> Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 and llama3.1-8b-instruct -> meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, no revision (https://github.com/CSSLab/Tacit/blob/995692d3cd42c32e08cf0db8a5fae55fec272f1a/tacit/config.py).

harness: AgentDojo 0.1.35 (PyPI/GitHub tag v0.1.35, 2025-10-27; https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/releases/tag/v0.1.35) per the collection script comment and the logs (census: agentdojo_package_version 0.1.35 in 2,076); installation not pinned in the repository (requirements.txt lists only the analysis stack: Python 3.11, torch 2.11.0, transformers 5.9.0, vllm 0.21.0 ...). Benchmark version v1.2.2 (census: 2,076) = 0.1.35's default; workspace has 14 injection tasks (6..13 added in v1.2/v1.2.1). Providers: Llama via AgentDojo's LOCAL client (pipeline_name `local`, AgentDojo's own prompting/parsing), Qwen via VLLM_PARSED (pipeline_name `vllm_parsed`, vLLM hermes parser). No defence. Known 0.1.35 defects relevant here: #150/#202 LocalLLM keeps only the first <function=...> call and drops fenced calls (https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/202); #219 LocalLLM drops calls with empty body or trailing text (https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/219); #220 LocalLLM turns server errors into an empty final answer scored as a failed attack (https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/220); #213 workspace injection_task_6..13 have empty ground truth (https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/213); #201 workspace v1.2.2 + important_instructions 0/560 on one model (https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/201); #181 banking injection tasks 0/1/3 subject check is dead code (https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/181); #168 slack injection_task_5 scored from attempted calls (https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/168); #188 slack utility KeyError when post_webpage does not execute (https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/188); #214 non-ASCII tool results as \uXXXX (https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/214); #88 TaskResults not fully defined under newer pydantic (https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/88). Semantics: the maintainer states security true = attack successful, and always true without an attack (https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/95). 0.1.35 imposes utility False / security True on context-length and server errors with a logged error (benchmark.py at v0.1.35); census: error null in 2,076. With an attack and a non-DoS attack, 0.1.35 first runs every injection task as a user task (pre-pass, logged under injection_task_*/none/) — none is in the tree.

discrepancy_leads: LABEL DIRECTION: paper Table 4 gives AgentDojo unsafe 369 / safe 1,706 and defines unsafe as 'agent completes the injected task'; the released loader labels unsafe = (security is False) and data/README.md expects unsafe = 1,706; AgentDojo's security is True on attack success and constant True on benign runs (#95). Our phase-10c census has security True 369 / False 1,706 / missing 1, so 369 = 194 benign (constant True) + 175 attacked successes. Either the paper's table and the training labels are swapped relative to the code, or the paper's 369 'injected task carried out' counts 194 benign runs that carry no injection. Test at L1 (security by attack_type) and with data/splits label field (supporting artefact).

COUNT: paper and loader 2,075 vs 2,076 released logs: the qwen workspace user_task_38 x injection_task_11 log (v1.k14.incomplete; census flags missing:security and missing:utility 1) is excluded by the loader.
